entry.title: The New RP Roam: More Range for Every Day
entry.excerpt: Meet the new RP Roam: a comfortable, capable e-bike built for longer commutes, everyday errands and more miles between charges.

children.text: The New RP Roam: More Range for Every Day

You already know what makes a Red Panda feel right: an easy, upright ride, practical details that earn their place and the confidence to take the long way home. The new RP Roam keeps that familiar feeling and gives you more room to ride.
Built for the miles you actually ride

The RP Roam is made for everyday distance. Its long-range battery helps you get through the morning commute, the school run and the unplanned coffee stop without watching the charge meter all day. When the route home gets a little longer, you have the freedom to keep going.
The ride is smooth and composed, with comfortable handling that feels natural from the first turn. It is ready for busy streets, quiet lanes and all the small detours that make a journey yours.

A dependable bike should fit into your routine, not add another thing to worry about. The RP Roam's battery is designed for regular riding and dependable range, so charging becomes part of the rhythm rather than a daily calculation.
That means more flexibility when plans change: a longer route after work, a visit across town or a weekend ride that starts with no particular destination in mind.
The Red Panda feeling, with more range

If your current bike has carried you through years of commutes and errands, you know the value of a bike that simply works. The new RP Roam brings that same practical character to a new generation, with more range for the daily commute and the confidence to go further.
It is classic Red Panda: comfortable, capable and ready for brighter days.
The new RP Roam is available to pre-order now. More range is only the beginning.
